note: Lenovo Z6 Youth / Z6 Lite (kunlun2 / L38111) stock boot.img from the device (Android 9, os_version 9.0.0)

header.cmdline: console=ttyMSM0,115200n8 earlycon=msm_geni_serial,0xA90000 androidboot.hardware=qcom androidboot.console=ttyMSM0 video=vfb:640x400,bpp=32,memsize=3072000 msm_rtb.filter=0x237 ehci-hcd.park=3 lpm_levels.sleep_disabled=1 service_locator.enable=1 androidboot.configfs=true androidboot.usbcontroller=a600000.dwc3 swiotlb=1 firmware_class.path=/vendor/firmware_mnt/image loop.max_part=7 buildvariant=user
header.id_note: 原厂 id 字段（Lenovo 打包器写入，非 AOSP sha1(kernel||len)）；bootloader 不使用，沿用原值以保持最小字节差异

stock.note: kernel-only boot image (Image.gz + appended DTB table); appended unsigned vbmeta (algorithm NONE) covers bytes 0..vbmeta_offset
